fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI trouve les observations de M. de Lapradelle très justes et très sérieuses. Il croit aussi fort importante l'observation du Président. Il faut concilier les deux points de vue, et on pourra le faire en donnant à tous les juges un traitement proportionnel à leurs services.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI thought that M. de Lapradelle's remarks were very true and very important. He thought that the remarks of the President were also of great importance. The two points of view must be reconciled by some means; this might be done by giving all the judges a salary in proportion to their services.
